assignments.evidence: Decodes to ato (x=a from xb=at 'bread', b=t, y=o from xhybt=apote); Meroitic ato 'water', paired with bread in offering formulas.
Decodes to pqr (h=p from htfkyu=pelmos, g=q from gyat=qore, a=r); Meroitic pqr 'crown prince'.
Decodes to tke (b=t, n=k from njqbt=kdite, t=e); Meroitic tke 'love, revere'.
Decodes to mk; it opens knjq 'goddess' (mk + kdi 'woman'); Meroitic mk 'god'.
Decodes to tre; a verb of giving fits (cf. Nubian tir- 'give'); offer vs take with xat is the main doubt.
Decodes to dime (j=d, q=i, k=m, t=e); Meroitic dime 'cow', the female of glossary vfoq=hlbi 'bull'.
Decodes to abr (o=b, which also turns vfoq into hlbi 'bull'); Meroitic abr 'man'.
Decodes to mlo (k=m, f=l from pelmos, y=o); Meroitic mlo 'good'.
Decodes to mhe (p = the second h letter); Meroitic mhe 'abundant', as in ato mhe 'abundant water'.
Decodes to ar (x=a, a=r); Meroitic ar 'boy, son'.
Decodes to ant (e=n, b=t); Meroitic ant 'priest, prophet' (ant of Amun).
Decodes to lh (f=l, p=h); Meroitic lh 'great, elder' (mk lh 'great god').
Decodes to kdi; it is the stem of njqbt 'sister' (kdite) and the tail of knjq 'goddess' (mk+kdi).
Decodes to ste (u=s from uuya=ssor and htfkyu=pelmos); Meroitic ste 'mother'.
Decodes to yerike (s=y from stbkjt=yetmde); Meroitic (t/y)erike 'begotten by', the father's partner of bjvt=tdhe 'born of (mother)'.
Decodes to a-S-r, S being the s-like letter of wk 'wife' and btrqwbq tewiSti 'adoration'; left by elimination, weakest pick.
Decodes to tbo (b=t, o=b, y=o), recalled as Meroitic 'two'; swapping with xwa is the main alternative.
Decodes to are, a verb form beside xa=ar 'boy'; best remaining fit for take, with offer (bat) the main doubt.
